svg.title: Hoffman–Martín–White sphere–plane shrinkers: handles and interior
svg.desc: Original genus-five topology schematic, full surface and cutaway. Alternating openings connect the caps to a central sheet and exterior. A separate inset shows the intersecting sphere–plane limit. The finite-genus drawing is not a computed shrinker.

g.text: Genus 5 topology model · informed by Figures 1, 5 and 6 · not a computed shrinker
Cutaway: inner sheet and lower cap
Gold and blue distinguish the two sides. All outer rims and cut edges are artificial.
Σg ∩ {z = 0} consists of g + 1 equally spaced lines.
Genus g exists for every g ≥ 1.
Exactly one end is proved for sufficiently large g.
As g → ∞, the limit is a sphere of radius 2 and a plane.
SCHEMATIC · finite-genus shape and cone slope are illustrative · no shrinker PDE has been solved
